from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    (r, c), (tr, tc) = points[1], points[2]
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
